pattern: proxy finish LIGHT (proxy_finish.py stage_light + proxy_finish_light.py): the frozen Pixal3D sheet proxy kept as generated (geometry + texture), made watertight, decimated, baked, optionally reposed with bones

config.body_tris_why: regular tier max 22000 INCLUDING the lid part (2000) -> shell 20000

fine.name: head
fine.why: the crown spikes, brim and face on a 2x finer grid

fine.name: maw
fine.why: the grafted maw (jaws x +-1.0, y -1.34..-0.02, z 1.7..5.04) on a 2x finer grid so the fangs stay crisp

cuts.why: the v6 torso front carved behind the grafted maw (the graft's own throat back wall at y -0.34..-0.45 replaces it), so the throat stays open

head_graft.frame_why: maw_v54.glb is stored in the v6 BODY frame (glTF y-up: (x, z, -y)), so yaw 90 / scale 1 / place 0 is the identity: q2 = body x (the mirror plane x = 0), q0 = body y, q1 = body z
head_graft.source_why: the v5.x OPEN proxy design/reference/duskmaw/proxy/duskmaw_open_proxy.glb (sha 89d09152, its own maw = the artist's 'that 2nd model') -> sheet frame (its intake transform) -> v5's frame fix (midline x 0.15, floor at the plate top z 0.2785, x1.041) -> y -0.14 (its throat back wall y -0.34..-0.45 sits inside the v6 waist, body back -0.15..-0.21); cropped to x +-1.05, y < -0.05, z 1.75..4.98 minus the arms (|x| > 0.8, y > -0.5), the -x half kept (the +x half has no throat back wall) + its mirror, welded, crop holes filled (scratch duskmaw_lane/py/crop_maw.py). Jaws front y -1.1..-1.33, rows z 2.3..4.9, x +-1.0 (sheet: rows z 2.59..4.86, x +-0.93; side view jaws ~1.2 u ahead of the back)
head_graft.cuts_why: the throat kept OPEN: the cropped (open) proxy shell makes the ray-parity occupancy fill the cavity, so the air behind the teeth (y -0.98..-0.47, z 3.15..4.35, |x| <= 0.52) and the gap between the rows in front (z 3.6..3.8) are removed from the graft. v6.2 lane 2: + a cylinder along x (axis y -1.9, z 1.5, r 1.34) bevels the v5.4 body bulk under the lower jaw (front y -1.2 down to the crop bottom z 1.7: a flat slab 0.55 u ahead of the v6 skirt in the side view) back to the v6 front: front y -1.2 at z 2.65 -> -0.96 at 2.45 -> -0.73 at 2.15, like the sheet's side view (the body recedes under the lower jaw)

tone.why: v5.4 maw texture: glossy purple-black body (L 6, a 6, b -7) -> matte body (L ~17, neutral); red teeth / gums (L 20..55, pure 134,0,1 .. 216,52,23) lifted toward the sheet's red; lane 2: the brightest reds (src L 46..52) -> orange (~L 60), src L < 41 stays red (gums), the few orange texels (src L 50..66) -> yellow-orange (L 68..85), so the fangs layer red -> orange -> yellow like the sheet (light.recolour3d cannot reach the graft atlas)

head_graft.why: artist on v6 / v6.1 + Codex 2026-10-25: v5.4's maw works (recessed dark throat, thick overlapping gums, dense tapered fangs); the flat parts could not reproduce it -> the v5.4 open proxy's own maw grafted into the v6 body (geometry + texture), the v6 torso carved behind it (light.cuts)

parts.name: lid
parts.why: the CLOSED state (closed sheet + Codex on v6.1: 'narrower, lower-reaching'): a body-tone shield shaped like the closed sheet's tear (rim x1.0 / z1.4 + 0.08 u, |x| <= 0.42, z 2.14..4.75) on the v6 torso front, the traced tear on it (x0.80 / z1.0, rim 0.55 u wide, z 2.42..4.18); built x0.2 about [0.0, -0.3, 3.6] (inside the waist solid behind the throat wall), the closed keys scale it x5

recolour3d.why: the v6 proxy's dark-red head back to the body tone (tips kept)

recolour3d.name: torso_stripe_reset
recolour3d.why: the v6 proxy's painted tear stripe reset (the graft / lid carry the mouth); box down to z 1.6 so the v6 torso front re-exposed under the bevelled lower jaw stays body-tone

recolour3d.name: spike_tips_red

recolour.name: throat
recolour.why: sheet: abyssal interior, red not black (artist v5.2) -> the grafted throat by depth behind the jaw front (y -1.0): dark red 180,40,44 at the gums -> 135,26,32 -> maroon 85,16,20 at the back wall (lane 2: 30,6,9 and 58,10,14 both read near-black under the baked AO; the sheet throat is dark RED); bright texels (the teeth) kept

glow3d.name: eyes
glow3d.why: the v6 proxy's own yellow eyes glow

glow3d.name: teeth_tips
glow3d.why: the fangs' TIPS glow yellow (sheet: red gum -> orange -> yellow tip): the tooth faces (red / orange albedo, not the dark body) in the tip bands (upper row z 3.8..4.12, lower row z 3.2..3.62; front y < -0.95, clear of the throat)

glow3d.name: teeth_mid
glow3d.why: the fangs' orange middles glow orange (orange-albedo tooth faces in the middle bands only; run 2 glowed every orange face -> one uniform orange)

rig.falloff_why: 0.05 H = 0.36 u: the squash moves the grafted jaws as smooth bands

chains.name: jaw_up
chains.why: the grafted UPPER jaw (rows z 3.9..4.9, front y -1.1..-1.33), per half from the midline; closed: scaled along (toward the midline) + across, moved back + down under the lid

chains.name: jaw_lo
chains.why: the grafted LOWER jaw (rows z 2.3..3.5); closed: scaled + back + up

chains.name: maw_corner
chains.why: the maw's flaring sides (x +-0.85..1.05); closed: pulled in + back so the torso slims

extra.name: idle
extra.why: PLACEHOLDER idle (artist 2026-10-24: the base form alternates closed / open): CLOSED f0-33 (maw squashed under the lid + tear), OPENS f33-49 (the grafted jaws spread out of the slim torso, the lid scales into it), held open f49-57, closes by f73; tendril + arm sway

extra.name: walk
extra.why: PLACEHOLDER walk = the artist's GLIDE (2026-09-25): the body slides, tendrils trail, no stepping; mouth CLOSED

extra.name: transform_out
extra.why: ONESHOT PLACEHOLDER: sinks 0.32 H into its tendrils, the tendrils flare, the maw opens; the game swaps to duskmaw_true_form at the last frame under a VFX

clips.why: clips.extra keyed poses: idle + walk REPLACE the kit clips; close + transform_out ONESHOT; all PLACEHOLDER

config._doc: duskmaw v6.2 LIGHT finish (2026-10-25): the clean closed v6 proxy (92da035a09ce) + the v5.4 OPEN proxy's own maw grafted (light.head_graft maw_graft/maw_v54.glb), the v6 torso carved behind it; CLOSED = the maw squashed by shell-weighted jaw / corner bones under a lid + traced tear part (improve/duskmaw_parts.py gen62). Rest = OPEN. Written by scratch duskmaw_lane2/py/gen_cfg62b.py (lane 2: lower-jaw bevel, fang tone + tip glow, throat red).

proxy_faces_cut.rule: proxy faces whose centroid lies inside a light.cuts volume leave the bake source (normal / AO / albedo) and the proxy-distance metrics

head_graft.why: artist on v6 / v6.1 + Codex 2026-10-25: v5.4's maw works (recessed dark throat, thick overlapping gums, dense tapered fangs); the flat parts could not reproduce it -> the v5.4 open proxy's own maw grafted into the v6 body (geometry + texture), the v6 torso carved behind it (light.cuts)
head_graft.rule: head glb -> its own mirror frame -> the good half folded (|q2|) = an exactly symmetric head; one similarity to the sheet side view; SDF smooth-unioned into the grid before the remesh; the good half's triangles + mirror into the bake source with the head texture in an atlas

high.rule: marching tets of the whole remesh grid (no mirror)

fine.rule: coarse cells inside the boxes not contoured; fine grid blended to the coarse Kuhn-linear field at the box faces; coarse/fine twins welded, coarse border triangles fanned through the T-junctions

low.method: collapse decimation: uniform to 300000, then 20000 with the dense boxes calibrated

dense.rule: dense boxes weighted 0.02 (vs 1) in the collapse decimation; the factor bisected until the boxes hold density x the rest's triangles per area

pre.rule: pre_tris collapse with the fine boxes weighted 0.02 (vs 1); factor bisected until the boxes keep the high's triangle share

rebalance.rule: the dense boxes' share of the final low held to the coarse-only pipeline's share, so light.fine changes WHERE the box triangles go, not how many

lid.rule: frozen closed mesh generated offline (duskmaw_parts.py gen), built x eps about the pivot
lid.why: the CLOSED state (closed sheet + Codex on v6.1: 'narrower, lower-reaching'): a body-tone shield shaped like the closed sheet's tear (rim x1.0 / z1.4 + 0.08 u, |x| <= 0.42, z 2.14..4.75) on the v6 torso front, the traced tear on it (x0.80 / z1.0, rim 0.55 u wide, z 2.42..4.18); built x0.2 about [0.0, -0.3, 3.6] (inside the waist solid behind the throat wall), the closed keys scale it x5

bake.source: the proxy mesh itself (not the remesh)

parts_material.name: duskmaw_parts
parts_material.rule: light.parts faces: Col (palette regions) -> Base Color, no baked texture

rows.why: the v6 proxy's own yellow eyes glow

the fangs' TIPS glow yellow (sheet: red gum -> orange -> yellow tip): the tooth faces (red / orange albedo, not the dark body) in the tip bands (upper row z 3.8..4.12, lower row z 3.2..3.62; front y < -0.95, clear of the throat)
the fangs' orange middles glow orange (orange-albedo tooth faces in the middle bands only; run 2 glowed every orange face -> one uniform orange)

glow3d.rule: faces -> glow palette regions (emission -> Glow -> Emission Color); rgb white keeps the baked albedo

mirror.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

floor.rule: stage 1 floored the FEET at z 0; the centring puts the lowest point at 0

facing.rule: shell centroid -> the front-most midline point of the shell (proxy finish default)

open_edges.rule: the watertight remesh, decimated (closed) + closed light.parts
